entities.name: Query Ham1-like protein
observations: 202-aa sequence; computed mass 21.17 kDa and theoretical pI 5.93; Pfam Ham1p_like (PF01725.22) match at residues 3–188.

Sequence has 52–56% identity over 92–96% query coverage to reviewed dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homologs; likely nucleotide-pool sanitizing pyrophosphatase, but function is homology-inferred for this query.
Close homolog annotations describe Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of XTP, dITP, and ITP to monophosphate plus diphosphate; homologs are annotated as cytosolic homodimers.
